AVAIL:Title: Labeled cutaway line drawing of Shuttle Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU)
AVAIL:Description: Labeled cutaway line drawing of the Shuttle extravehicular mobility unit (EMU) identifies its various components and equipment. The portable life support system (PLSS) and protective layers of fabric (thermal micrometeoroid garment (TMG)) incorporated in this extravehicular activity (EVA) space suit are shown.
